note: Illinois DNR fish and wildlife area northwest of Johnsonville, on 194-acre Sam Dale Lake. Two shady, wooded electric campgrounds: Hickory Hollow, and Lake View on a peninsula whose outer sites sit in the trees some 45-55 m above the shore. Sassafras Point has hike-in tent sites. Boat dock, playground. --Claude
